name: Mango juice
description: Thick sweet pulp thinned and sweetened — sold in cartons year-round.

tcm.note: Follows the ripe mango, which TCM reads as cool.

ayurveda.note: Ripe mango's own entry marks its virya contested — some schools call it ushna and rakta-aggravating, others cooling — so this drink inherits that split rather than asserting it flatly.

unani.note: Aam is garam-tar in desi usage, which is why it is soaked in water before eating.

histamine.note: Low, though the sugar load in carton nectar is considerable.
